body: Google released Gemini 4 Argon on 13 October. Developers pay $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input discounted by 95%.
Argon is rolling out across AI Studio, Google's enterprise products, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, making it one of the widest launches of a frontier model so far.
dek: The new model is live for developers and in the Gemini app and Search.
title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is out, priced to undercut rivals
